evidence.observation: Overshot briefly to 760.3 °C at the start of growth, then held at 750 ±0.3 °C
Dropped from about 85% during the ramp to a steady 45–46% for the hold, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping
Purge brought O2 down to single-digit ppm, and it has stayed there (4–8 ppm)
Steady at about 761.5 Torr with no drift
Tracking its 100 sccm setpoint within ±1 sccm

args.missing_evidence: Characterization of the sample after the run (for example Raman or microscopy) to show whether the target material grew; there are no normal-run reference values to compare the readings against.
